messages:
Alex (product): Starting a quick sync: we need a concise discovery endpoint for model capability flags that customers can poll. Key asks from sales: per-model token caps, explicit streaming modes, and clear function/tool support.
Rina (eng-platform): High-level goal: single stable contract so SDKs can cache. Proposal: `GET /v1/models/:id/capabilities` -> returns small JSON with booleans, numeric limits, and optional `manifest_url`. Keep the payload <8kb.
Devon (eng-ml): Add `model_class` (e.g., \"decoder\", \"encoder\") and `recommended_quantization` so clients can pick compatibility layers. Embedding models also need `embedding_dim` and `is_deterministic`.
Priya (sales): Real buyers ask for: 1) `supports_tooling: [\"browser\", \"sql\", \"http_call\"]`, 2) `streaming: {\"enabled\": true, \"protocols\": [\"sse\", \"websocket\"]}`, 3) `max_context_tokens` + `max_response_tokens`. If we surface `tools` include `auth_required` flags.
Rina (eng-platform): Operational constraints: signed `manifest_url` (short-lived) instead of embedding full tool lists. We'll also include `capabilities_etag` and `updated_at`. Caching guidance in headers: `Cache-Control` + `ETag`.
Devon (eng-ml): For function calling we should indicate `supported_call_payloads` (e.g., \"json_schema\", \"proto\") and `schema_url` if applicable. Also mark `sanitization_required` for models with redaction flows.
Priya (sales): Important: customers want an explicit fallback contract. Add `compatible_variants` array with model IDs and a `compatibility_notes` string to explain differences (e.g., lower throughput, no streaming).
infra-bot: infra: scheduled rollout of discovery-service v1 -> staging 2024-11-07T04:00Z (pipeline 4902)
Rina (eng-platform): Proposed minimal response example to discuss:
```
{
  "features": ["streaming","function_calling","json_schema_output"],
  "limits": {"max_context_tokens":"8192","max_output_tokens":"2048"},
  "manifest_url":"https://signed.cdn/...",
  "capabilities_etag":"2024-11-01-v1",
  "compatible_variants":["rm-large-v2","rm-medium-v1"]
}
```
Rina (eng-platform): Note: numeric limits as strings to avoid language JSON int issues in some SDKs — open to debate.
Alex (product): Launch criteria draft:
- canonical endpoint implemented and documented
- streaming flag maps to actual SSE/ws behavior in runtime
- manifest URL signed and TTL 30m
- two customer validation sessions (one for embeddings, one for chat+tools)
- QA: golden prompt set for structured output; <=3% regression on schema conformance
Devon (eng-ml): Add internal check: onboarding pipeline must populate these fields automatically; don't allow manual free-text for `features`.
Priya (sales): Also request a `visibility` flag: \"public\" | \"enterprise\" so sales know if we can share the schema URL by default.
Rina (eng-platform): Will add `visibility` and `signed_schema_url` conditional on tenancy. Infra will enforce size limits and return `manifest_url` when appropriate.
Alex (product): OK — next steps: Rina/Devon prototype API shape by EOD Thursday, infra provide caching/signing plan, Priya will compile two customer test cases. We'll reconvene with a short demo. Flag blockers here.
